text:
[Council File 26-1645; CD 9]
Motion (Price - Jurado) relative to a Request for Proposals for the selection of a qualified vendor to lease, manage, and maintain the Slauson Connect Recreation and Education Center located on Slauson Avenue from Normandie Avenue to Budlong Avenue in Council District 9. (This matter is also referred to the Civil Rights, Immigration, Social Services and Neighborhoods Committee.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to seek a vendor through a request for proposals to lease, manage and maintain the Slauson Connect Recreation and Education Center on Slauson Avenue in Council District 9.
